trap.label: pode ter + particípio
trap.wrong: She might to have missed the bus.
trap.right: She might have missed the bus.
trap.why: O português "pode ter perdido" leva o aluno a inserir to. Depois de might/could, usa-se have + particípio diretamente.

opts: We could have gone by train.
mcq.why: could have + particípio = poderíamos ter ido (mas não fomos).

mcq.q: Complete: The keys **___** be in the car. (talvez estejam)
mcq.why: Presente: might + verbo base; passado: might have.

mcq.q: Qual tem sentido de possibilidade fraca?
opts: It might have been a mistake.
It must have been a mistake.

fix.wrong: I might to have left it at home.
fix.right: I might have left it at home.

fix.wrong: We could went by bus yesterday, but we walked.
fix.right: We could have gone by bus yesterday, but we walked.
fix.why: Possibilidade passada não realizada: could have + particípio.

fix.wrong: It might not has been him.
fix.right: It might not have been him.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “She might be late.” (talvez tenha se atrasado)
Reescreva com could have: “We can take a taxi.” (oportunidade perdida)
rewrite.answer: We could have taken a taxi.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva na negativa: “He may have seen it.”
rewrite.answer: He may not have seen it.
